form.primaryCloud: Primary root on a cloud drive:
form.cloudNewFiles: New downloads are first added to the local staging folder and can be played immediately. They upload to this cloud folder in the background, usually instantly. Local copies are removed after verification.
form.makeCloudPrimaryHint: Store new content in this cloud folder. Files upload here after being added; the local folder is only used for staging.
form.needStaging: A server folder is also needed for staging new files before upload and for storing posters and subtitles.
form.needPrimary: A server folder is also needed as the primary root for new downloads, posters and subtitles.
form.cloudExistingUpload: New downloads can be played immediately while they upload in the background, usually instantly. Local copies are removed after verification. Existing local files upload from newest to oldest and are removed one by one. Uploads automatically give way to remote viewers.
form.cloudExistingHint: Existing movies in cloud folders are identified by file name and added to the library. Files are neither downloaded nor changed. Later additions, moves and deletions in the cloud folders are followed automatically.
form.changeFolderHint: Click to choose a different folder, starting from the current path.
form.stagingHint: Local staging folder: new files stay here before upload. Hard links use no extra space. Posters and subtitles are also stored here.
form.primaryMeaning: Primary root = where new content is stored.
form.primaryHint: Completed subscriptions and manual downloads are added under primary root/Title (Year). A library can have several roots, but only the primary root receives new content.
form.makeLocalPrimaryHint: Use this folder for new content by moving it to the top of the list. Existing files will not be moved.
form.browseServer: Browse and add a server folder
form.scanOnSaveSuffix: · Saving starts a scan of existing files
form.typeHint: The type controls scanning, presentation and subscription support. It cannot be changed after creation.
form.name: Name
form.primaryNote: (The first is the primary root for new content)
form.scopeFallback: Current: no scope set. This library receives all unmatched titles of this type.
form.customCoverHint: You are using an uploaded cover. Restoring automatic covers builds a collage from the most recently added titles.
form.autoCoverHint: The cover is an automatic collage of the four most recently added titles. Upload an image to replace it.
form.coverUploadHint: Use a 21:10 landscape image, such as 1260×600. Uploads are compressed to JPEG with a 1600 px long edge. The dashboard and Jellyfin clients use the same cover. Changes apply immediately without saving.
form.everyoneHint: Available to all members, including future members, except those restricted to selected libraries in member management.
form.selectedHint: Only selected people can browse this library. Others will not see it on the home page, in search, in recent viewing or in players. You can always manage it.
form.noViewersWarning: No one, including you, can currently browse this library. You can still manage it here.
form.viewerPlaceholder: Search by nickname or username to choose viewers
form.keepLocalHint: When on, keep the local copy after upload as a backup, without freeing space. When off, remove the local copy after verifying the upload and finishing local processing such as media details and intro detection. Playback then reads from the cloud drive.
form.autoCover: Automatic collage of recently added titles
form.watchChanges: Monitor folder changes in real time
form.networkWatchHint: The root is on a network mount (NFS/SMB), which does not deliver remote change notifications. No watcher is created even when this is on. Scheduled reconciliation finds new files; change its interval in Settings → Application → Scheduled tasks. Incremental checks usually take seconds.
form.watchHint: Automatically scan and add new files when they arrive. SMB/NFS mounts do not deliver remote change notifications and take time to set up watchers, so monitoring should be turned off for them. Scheduled checks and manual scans still find every new file, with a delay.
form.clearMissingAfterScan: Automatically clear missing records after scans
form.clearMissingHint: After files are deleted from disk, clear their records when a scan finishes. Only records are deleted; files on disk are kept. This cannot be undone, and the missing-item redownload action disappears too. When off, records are kept and restored when files return. Scans that cannot read a folder never clear its records.
form.frameFallback: Use video frames for missing images
form.scrapedFrameHint: Use a frame from the video for unidentified files and episodes without a TMDB still. Prefer TMDB images whenever available. Frame capture reads each file on network mounts; turn it off to save traffic and show placeholders instead.
form.localFrameHint: Use a video frame when no online poster is available. Prefer a matching image file or embedded cover before capturing a frame. Frame capture reads each file on network mounts; turn it off to save traffic and show placeholders instead.
form.thumbnailHint: Resize originals to a 720 px long edge for album-wall thumbnails. The grid only loads thumbnails. When off, it loads originals, which can be slow for large photos. Only turn this off to save traffic on large network-mounted libraries.
form.chaptersHint: Capture an image for each embedded chapter, or split a video into 3–12 chapters by duration. The title page shows a chapter row; select an image to play from there. Players such as Infuse can also use these chapters. Each file needs several seeks, so this uses CPU and read traffic and is off by default. Turning it on fills existing videos in the background at low priority, then follows scans and imports. Turning it off stops generation and hides the chapter row, but keeps images for reuse. Embedded chapters remain available on the player timeline.
form.introsHint: Compare audio from the first 10 minutes and last 7 minutes of each episode with other episodes in its season to detect intros, credits and sponsor segments. Playback offers Skip intro and shows Up next when credits begin. Players such as Infuse can use the results too. New episodes are processed as they arrive. Turning this on fills existing series in the background at low priority, with followed series first. Turning it off disables detection and playback buttons, but keeps results for reuse.
form.homeDisplayHint: When off, skip this library in Recently added and Jellyfin’s Latest media. Its library card remains visible and you can still browse it.
form.autoCollections: Create collections automatically from movie series
form.tmdbCollectionsHint: Series such as Harry Potter or Mission: Impossible appear as collections in release order. See missing movies and find them in one click. This is a **display** preference: series data is still stored and written to NFO files when off, so Kodi/Emby are unaffected. It only stops automatic collections from appearing here. Turning it back on fills existing series without fetching metadata again.
form.unsetScopeHint: No scope set (receives unmatched titles of this type)
form.scopeEditHint: Choose what this library collects. Subscriptions and automatic imports select it based on a title’s characteristics. Leave all fields empty to set no scope.
form.typeFixed: The type cannot be changed after creation
